qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:Workload is measured, not inferred from a timeout number; Runtime and model evidence
evidence: Static nesting is sound: each gate judge is 600s (both gates judge.toml:4), summed serial gate limits 1200 < gates suite 1500 (tests/test.sh:207,213); scored limits are functional 9000 plus polish 900 plus visual 900 = 10800 < scored suite 11100 (judge.toml:4 and test.sh:224). Suite budgets total 12600 < verifier 13200 (task.toml:[verifier]), leaving 600s outer overhead; agent 7200 and environment cold-build 600 match the frozen template. Liveness uses 120 attempts, 0.25s sleeps and 2s HTTP timeouts (test.sh:48-50,116-121); this is not a measured strict 30s wall-clock bound. Restart tool timeout is 55s (restart_mcp.py:11,39). Functional has 23 criteria with real-key, pointer, formatting, boundary, stale-state and restart work; prompt.md:9 permits grouped observations. Raw evidence index input hash matches this assignment and all three indexed artifact SHA256 values were verified against current bytes. Browser log contains successful scripted probes (runtime matrix 22.5997503s), not configured judge timing; persistence log shows manually replaced PID 173 -> 210, not elapsed full verifier execution. Index explicitly says full judge duration remains unavailable. Neither agent build sufficiency, cold build sufficiency nor complete configured judge/suite workload is measured here, so the required runtime claim cannot pass.
counterexample: Budget arithmetic also passes for a weak app that quickly fails its early browser probes. A conforming custom editor can require substantially more browser discovery, real keyboard/pointer actions, copied source checks and independent-context readbacks across all 23 functional criteria; without configured timing, its completion within 9000s is unestablished. This is a workload evidence gap, not a demonstrated timeout defect.
suggested_fix: Obtain authorized hash-bound cold-build, builder and full configured judge/verifier timing evidence for these frozen bytes, including MCP startup and all criteria; keep canonical budgets until a measured reason supports an explicitly authorized below-five-hour adjustment.
